name: CO2 laser
indication_summary: Endoscopic resection of membranous/web-like SGS; precise scar vaporization.
location_notes: Subglottis; maintain parallel approach to wall.
limitations_and_risks: Limited coagulation compared with Nd:YAG; depth must be controlled.
evidence_notes: Improvement declines with higher Myer-Cotton grades.

name: Nd:YAG laser
limitations_and_risks: Greater depth of penetration may injure cartilage; operator control critical.
evidence_notes: Reliable results in early/mild SGS; multiple procedures may be required.

name: Balloon dilator
limitations_and_risks: Relatively ineffective alone in extensive/firm SGS.
cautions: Combine with resection/adjuvants in firm/extensive SGS.
post_procedure_care: Monitor for recurrence; spirometry + bronchoscopy follow-up.
evidence_notes: Effective in adults and pediatrics; higher recurrence if used alone in ISGS.

name: Topical mitomycin-C (0.4 mg/ml)
advantages: Inhibits fibroblast proliferation; may improve patency interval.
limitations_and_risks: May delay but not prevent recurrence; higher concentrations unsafe.
cautions: Protect skin/eyes; irrigate with saline; dispose properly.
post_procedure_care: Standard wound care; monitor for complications.
evidence_notes: Safety acceptable with irrigation; evidence from retrospective series.

name: Intralesional corticosteroids
advantages: Prolongs procedure-free interval in selected patients.
best_for: GPA and other inflammatory SGS with scarring.
cautions: Systemic effects possible if large doses used.
post_procedure_care: Monitor voice and airway; interval ~7 months reported in series.
evidence_notes: Systematic review shows longer procedure-free interval and small V-RQOL gains.

name: Silicone stent (Dumon-type)
indication_summary: Benign complex SGS; >50% residual narrowing after other therapy; bridge to surgery/systemic therapy.
location_notes: Keep ≥10 mm below vocal cords if possible.
limitations_and_risks: Migration; granulation (risk rises near vocal cords).
best_for: Non-surgical candidates; complex stenosis; temporary stabilization.
cautions: Avoid in active burn/blast stenoses; severe dysphagia.
evidence_notes: Granulation risk 63% at ≤10 mm, 22% at 11–20 mm, 11% at ≥20 mm.

name: Montgomery T-tube
indication_summary: Alternative to intraluminal stent to avoid migration or when tracheotomy exists.
limitations_and_risks: High need for further treatments; requires tracheotomy care.
best_for: High migration risk; permanent contraindication to surgery.

name: Expandable metallic stent
indication_summary: Reserve for palliation in malignant SGS.
location_notes: Avoid permanent use in benign disease.
limitations_and_risks: Significant long-term complications in benign airway; difficult removal.
evidence_notes: Avoid in benign conditions per guideline.
